story: Kofi and Hana visit a museum to see art. They see a large painting and a beautiful picture. Hana is an artist, and Kofi is a tall actor. They also listen to music from a band with a guitar and a piano. They see a photograph and some colorful paint too.
title: A Day at the Museum
setting: A bright, modern art museum with large walls.

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: A tall young man with short black hair and a green shirt.

characters.name: Hana
characters.look: A young woman with long brown hair and a yellow dress.

sentences.en: Kofi and Hana walk into the big museum.
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a tall man in a green shirt, and Hana, a woman in a yellow dress, walk through the large doors of a museum.

sentences.en: Kofi is a very tall actor.
sentences.zh: Kofi是一个非常高大的演员。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a tall man in a green shirt, stands next to Hana.

sentences.en: Hana is a great artist too.
sentences.zh: Hana也是一位伟大的艺术家。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana, a woman in a yellow dress, holds a small brush.

sentences.en: They look at a large painting.
sentences.zh: 他们看一幅巨大的绘画作品。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi and Hana look at a large painting on a white wall.

sentences.en: They also see a pretty picture.
sentences.zh: 他们也看到一张漂亮的图片。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi and Hana look at a small picture on the wall.

sentences.en: The reason for the visit is art.
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi and Hana stand in a room full of art.

sentences.en: A band plays a guitar and a piano.
sentences.zh: 一个乐队演奏着吉他和钢琴。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small band plays a guitar and a piano in the museum corner.

sentences.en: They see a photograph on the wall.
sentences.zh: 他们在墙上看到一张照片。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi and Hana look at a photograph in a frame on the wall.

sentences.en: A jar of red paint is on a table.
sentences.zh: 桌子上有一个红色的颜料罐。
sentences.scene_prompt: A jar of red paint sits on a small table.
Kofi and Hana listen to the music in the museum.
